chunks: Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn 'Ali ibn al-Husayn narrated to us, he said: My father narrated to me, he said: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar narrated to me, he said: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa narrated to us, from 'Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Sulayman ibn Khalid, from Abu 'Abdillah Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq, from his forefathers, peace be upon them, who said: The Messenger of God, peace be upon him and his family, said to 'Ali, peace be upon him:
"O 'Ali, you are from me and I am from you. Your friend is my friend, and my friend is the friend of God. And your enemy is my enemy, and my enemy is the enemy of God.
O 'Ali, I am at war with whoever fights you, and at peace with whoever is at peace with you. O 'Ali, you have a treasure in Paradise, and you are the master of its two sides.

O 'Ali, you are the divider of Paradise and Hell — none shall enter Paradise except one who has recognized you and whom you have recognized, and none shall enter Hell except one who has rejected you and whom you have rejected.

O 'Ali, you and the Imams from your descendants shall stand upon the Heights on the Day of Resurrection, recognizing the sinners by their marks and the believers by their signs. O 'Ali, were it not for you, the believers would not have been distinguished after me."

key_terms.الأعراف: The Heights — an elevated place between Paradise and Hell mentioned in Quran 7:46-48, where 'Ali and the Imams will stand on the Day of Judgment
key_terms.ذو قرنيها: Master of its two sides — referring to 'Ali's dominion over both sides of Paradise
key_terms.قسيم الجنة والنار: Divider of Paradise and Hell — a title of Imam 'Ali indicating his role in determining the fate of souls

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about Imam Ali's role on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In this prophetic tradition from al-Amali of al-Mufid, the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) addresses Imam 'Ali (AS) in a series of declarations establishing his supreme spiritual station. Transmitted through a reliable chain via Imam al-Sadiq (AS), the Prophet declares that 'Ali is inseparable from him, that 'Ali's friends and enemies are aligned with God's, that 'Ali holds the keys to Paradise, and that 'Ali and the Imams from his lineage will stand on al-A'raf (the Heights, referenced in Quran 7:46) on the Day of Judgment to distinguish believers from sinners.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 4. He said: Abu Ja’far Muhammad ibn ‘Ali ibn al-Husayn reported to me from his father, who reported from Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar, who reported from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from ‘Ali ibn Al-Hakam, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Sulaiman ibn Khalid, from Abu Abdillah Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, from his forefathers, peace be upon them, who said: The Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, told ‘Ali, peace be upon him:
"O ‘Ali, you are from me and I from you. Your friend is my friend and my friend is Allah’s friend. And your enemy is my enemy and my enemy is the enemy of Allah.
O ‘Ali, I am at war with the one who fights you and at peace with one who is at peace with you. O ‘Ali, you have a treasure in the Heaven and you are the master of its both sides.

O ‘Ali, you are the divider of heaven and hell. None shall enter the heaven unless he has recognized you, and you have recognized him! And none shall enter hell unless he has rejected you and you have rejected him.

O ‘Ali, you and your descendants shall be on the heights (al-A’araaf) on the Day of Judgment, recognizing the sinners by their marks, and the believers by their signs. O ‘Ali, the believers would not have been distinguished, after I have departed, if you were not there."
